bagPolicy.summary: No backpacks or bags of any size are admitted; each attendee may bring one personal wallet or clutch no larger than 9 × 5 × 2 inches.
allowed: One clutch or wallet up to 9 × 5 × 2 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Self-parking at Virgin Hotels Las Vegas is complimentary.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Set your ride to Virgin Hotels Las Vegas, 4455 Paradise Road. Taxi, Uber, and Lyft pickup and drop-off is at the front main entrance porte-cochere.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: There are full-service bars on all three theater levels. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: For specific accessible seating or other accommodations, the Theater asks guests to contact the box office staff.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Theater FAQ says guests who smoke must leave the theater but does not state a general concert re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is at the Theater box office during show hours; after closing, security and usher leads can access remaining will-call tickets. The box office outside the main theater entrance opens at 1 p.m. on event days and closes when the headliner starts.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The box office is outside the main Theater entrance inside the resort and opens at 1 p.m. on event days. Each attendee aged four or older needs a ticket; check the event page for door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
